enabled.description: When false the recorder cannot be started and the transcript cannot be submitted.

language.description: ISO-639-1 language for this recorder (e.g. 'en', 'de'). Leave blank to use the gateway default / auto-detect setting.

audioSource.description: What to record. 'microphone': the user's mic (echo cancellation removes speaker playback). 'tab': audio of a browser tab, window, or screen the user shares (Chrome/Edge desktop; the user must enable 'Also share tab audio'). 'mixed': microphone and shared tab audio, transcribed separately and labelled [Microphone] / [System audio] in the transcript.

showTimestamps.description: Prefix each transcript line with its time from the start of the recording, e.g. [00:05]. Each segment gets its own line. The timestamps are part of the stored transcript.

sourceColors.description: Colours of the [Microphone] / [System audio] labels and [mm:ss] timestamps in the transcript box (any CSS colour).

chunkIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) audio is sliced and uploaded for a partial transcript. 0 uses the gateway setting.

pushToTalk.description: Hold-to-record keyboard shortcut. Ignored while focus is inside a text field.

key.description: KeyboardEvent.code of the push-to-talk key, e.g. 'Space', 'KeyR', 'F8'.

autoSubmit.description: Submit as soon as recording stops instead of letting the user edit the transcript first.

showSummary.description: Show the LLM summary of the last submission under the transcript.

placeholder.default: Press the microphone (or hold Space) and start speaking...

transcript.description: The transcript box (a running log). Recordings are appended; it is only emptied by the Clear button or by writing this property (e.g. "" from a script or binding). Submit saves only the text below the last '---- Submitted hh:mm:ss ----' divider.

status.description: Read-only. idle | recording | transcribing | ready | submitting | submitted | error

error.description: Read-only. Last error message, blank when healthy.

lastSubmission.description: Read-only. The document most recently stored in MongoDB (plus its _id).
